title: Biology: Cells to Ecosystems
subject: Biology
description: A full-year biology survey built around observation, labs you can do at home, and one big dissection of curiosity.

milestones.title: Science of life and the chemistry within
milestones.description: What makes something alive; water, atoms, and the molecules of life.
milestones.projectIdea: Kitchen chemistry: test for starch and sugar in household foods.

milestones.title: Cell structure and function
milestones.description: Organelles, plant vs animal cells, and microscopy skills.
milestones.projectIdea: Build a cell model from kitchen materials — edible ones earn bonus taste points.

milestones.title: Cell transport and energy
milestones.projectIdea: Osmosis lab: eggs in vinegar, corn syrup, and water — document the changes daily.

milestones.title: Cell division
milestones.description: Mitosis, meiosis, and why cells divide.
milestones.projectIdea: Onion root tip observation: draw and count dividing cells from an online slide.

milestones.title: Classical genetics
milestones.description: Mendel, Punnett squares, and inherited traits.
milestones.projectIdea: Family trait survey: build a pedigree for a trait like tongue-rolling or dimples.

milestones.title: DNA and molecular genetics
milestones.description: The double helix, replication, and protein synthesis.
milestones.projectIdea: Extract strawberry DNA in your kitchen with soap, salt, and rubbing alcohol.

milestones.title: Evolution and natural selection
milestones.description: Evidence, mechanisms, and the history of life.
milestones.projectIdea: Predator-prey simulation with paper 'bugs' in different habitats over five generations.

milestones.title: Bacteria and viruses
milestones.description: The invisible world: helpful, harmful, and everywhere.
milestones.projectIdea: Grow household bacteria in agar plates made from gelatin and beef broth.

milestones.title: Plants and fungi
milestones.description: Plant structures, reproduction, and the decomposers.
milestones.projectIdea: Grow three identical plants in different conditions and journal six weeks of results.

milestones.title: Animals and invertebrates
milestones.description: Animal body plans, behaviors, and classification.
milestones.projectIdea: Backyard field survey: catalog ten species with a proper field notebook.

milestones.title: Human body systems
milestones.description: From circulation to digestion: the systems that keep you running.
milestones.projectIdea: Measure your own vitals: resting heart rate before and after a week of exercise.

milestones.title: Ecology and populations
milestones.description: Energy flow, cycles, and how populations grow and crash.
milestones.projectIdea: Local food web poster from your survey — who eats whom in your yard?

milestones.title: Ecosystems and conservation
milestones.description: Biomes, biodiversity, and what's worth protecting.
milestones.projectIdea: Choose an endangered species and design a conservation plan for it.

milestones.title: Lab skills and the scientific method
milestones.description: Variables, controls, data, and honest conclusions.
milestones.projectIdea: Design a full experiment of your own: question, hypothesis, methods, results.

milestones.title: Capstone: The biology of something you love
milestones.description: Deep-dive into the biology behind any passion: a sport, an animal, baking, gaming.
milestones.projectIdea: Produce an illustrated guide or video: 'The hidden biology of ___.'
